component.name: Hyprism
component.summary: Manage Hytale instances, profiles and mods

description.p: Hyprism is an unofficial Hytale launcher for managing isolated game instances, profiles and mods. It supports official account authentication and browsing mods.
This community package repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified. A licensed Hytale account is needed to download the game from the official servers.
